ranked_facts.concept_key: Histopathology: well-developed cornoid lamellae with a decreased granular layer
ranked_facts.why: The presence of well-developed cornoid lamellae with a decreased granular layer is a characteristic histopathological feature of Eruptive Pruritic Papular Porokeratosis (EPPP), which distinguishes it from other porokeratosis variants.

ranked_facts.concept_key: Chief complaint: 3-month history of rapidly spreading intensively pruritic papules on her extremities
ranked_facts.why: The rapid spread and intense pruritus of the papules are more consistent with Eruptive Pruritic Papular Porokeratosis (EPPP) than with other forms of porokeratosis, which tend to have a more gradual onset and less severe symptoms.
